headline: South Asia: A year on, where does Trump's Gaza peace plan stand?
script:
Good morning. This is your global conflict briefing.

BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT:
- South Asia: A year on, where does Trump's Gaza peace plan stand?.
- Western Russia: Air Force: Russia attacks with 160 drones, more than half jet-powered, strikes recorded at 14 locations.

United States - bottom line: Pentagon, Raytheon sign $6.3B deal to replenish US missile interceptor supply.
- Military Times, 15 hours ago: Pentagon, Raytheon sign $6.3B deal to replenish US missile interceptor supply.

Three soldiers sprang into action when a highway crash in Washington turned into a knife attack on two children.
The Caribbean - bottom line: StJMC mulls action against companies for hanging wires.
- Jamaica Gleaner, 6 hours ago: StJMC mulls action against companies for hanging wires.
WESTERN BUREAU: The St James Municipal Corporation is calling on telecommunications companies with low-hanging wires, which were displaced by Hurricane Melissa a year ago, to address them immediately or risk legal action in the interest of the public safety. Montego Bay Mayor Richard Vernon issued the warning on Thursday at the St James Municipal Corporation’s (StJMC) City Hall 2026 Municipal Budget Presentation at the Montego Bay Cultural Centre, where he outlined plans for the corporation’s $2.8-billion budget expenditure for the 2027-2028 financial year.

- Ukrainska Pravda, one hour ago: Russian forces attack two districts of Kharkiv, hitting medical facility and injuring civilians.
Russian forces attacked Kharkiv's Kholodnohirskyi and Slobidskyi districts on 10 October. A drone struck a medical facility in the Slobidskyi district, injuring two people.

ASIA
South Asia - bottom line: A year on, where does Trump's Gaza peace plan stand?.
- Dawn (Pakistan), Jerusalem Post, one hour ago: A year on, where does Trump's Gaza peace plan stand?.
On Oct 10, 2025, Israel began pulling its troops from parts of Gaza as a peace agreement it signed with Hamas went into effect. A year later, it has expanded its occupation to about 70 per cent of the Palestinian territory — one of its many violations of that ceasefire. The 20-point peace plan envisaged by United States President Donald Trump, titled ‘Comprehensive Plan to End Gaza Conflict’, has not just remained stalled; it has been torn apart by Washington’s own ally Israel. At the time, Trump had touted the plan as a breakthrough that would bring “eternal peace” to the Middle East.
- Dawn (Pakistan), South China Morning Post - China, 5 hours ago: Trump sows doubt on plan to livestream US military execution.
US President Donald Trump has cast doubt on whether authorities will livestream the firing squad execution of the perpetrator of a deadly attack on American soldiers, a plan that has drawn broad and bipartisan condemnation, it emerged on Saturday. Nidal Hasan’s execution — scheduled for December 3 at Fort Hood, Texas, where he gunned down 13 people in 2009 — is set to be the first by a US military firing squad since 1945.

- Dawn (Pakistan), 16 hours ago: Afridi invites people from across country to join PTI's long march at Swabi Interchange on Oct 11.
PESHAWAR: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Chief Minister Sohail Afridi invited people from across Pakistan to reach the Swabi Interchange on Oct 11, where the PTI plans to announce the next steps for its long march that is being carried out to demand the release of jailed party founder Imran Khan. The route plan for the march has undergone multiple changes since its launch on Oct 4. While the party initially vowed to march towards Islamabad, its final destination seemingly remains tentative as the KP CM has yet to announce the plan for the trek after Oct 11, beyond Swabi.

- Times of India - Top Stories, 3 hours ago: 'Send male officers forward’: Dipke tells women cops aboard flight before detention.
CJP convenor Abhijeet Dipke was detained at Delhi airport just before the planned Jantar Mantar protest. Dipke challenged police actions and demanded to speak with male officers during the detention.
